thesis: The speaker explains that Institutional Investor, founded in 1967 as a print magazine, underwent a strategic review starting in late 2017 due to the high costs of printing and shipping. Consequently, the company decided to cease print publication after 508 issues on April 1st, a move that allowed them to spend more on journalism by reducing physical production expenses.
